projects.title: DisQueue: Distributed Task Queue & Worker Engine
projects.summary: A resilient, distributed background job processing system with guaranteed at-least-once delivery, exponential backoff, and live dashboard.
projects.description: Engineered a scalable distributed background worker orchestrator from scratch. Features priority-based queues, dead-letter queue (DLQ) retry strategies, worker heartbeat monitoring, and an interactive monitoring dashboard. Uses MySQL transactions and Redis locks to prevent race conditions during concurrent consumer processing.
projects.architecture_highlights: Designed multi-threaded worker pools with atomic MySQL state transitions (PENDING -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED). Implemented heartbeat leases to re-enqueue orphaned tasks if a worker fails.
projects.metrics: Processes 2,500+ tasks/sec with <15ms average latency; zero lost tasks during worker crash simulation tests.

projects.title: FinTrack: Algorithmic Personal Wealth & Expense Analytics
projects.summary: Full-stack financial tracking suite with predictive budget forecasting, visual transaction graphs, and automated receipt categorization.
projects.description: Architected an end-to-end financial intelligence web application. Features secure JWT session handling, normalized MySQL financial ledger tables, multi-currency conversion, and dynamic SVG chart visualizations. Provides automated recurring subscription detection and CSV bank statement ingestion.
projects.architecture_highlights: Implemented double-entry bookkeeping in MySQL with foreign key cascading and balance verification constraints. Optimized analytical monthly queries via composite index on (user_id, date, category).
projects.metrics: Sub-40ms response time on 100,000+ transaction datasets; 99.8% category classification accuracy.

projects.title: DevPulse: Real-Time Collaborative Code Sandbox
projects.summary: Browser-based pair-programming workspace with low-latency operational transformation, multi-tab execution, and AST linting.
projects.description: Built a browser-based collaborative programming IDE where two or more engineers can write, format, and execute JavaScript and Python snippets simultaneously. Features WebSocket room coordination, syntax highlighting, live terminal output streaming, and session replay.
projects.architecture_highlights: Isolated user code execution within resource-capped ephemeral Docker containers. Employs CRDT-inspired conflict resolution over WebSockets with state persistence in MySQL.
projects.metrics: <25ms typing latency synchronization across international connections; 0 security container escapes.

projects.title: CloudVault: S3-Compatible Encrypted Object Store
projects.summary: Secure object storage API supporting chunked multipart uploads, client-side AES-256-GCM encryption, and signed pre-authenticated URLs.
projects.description: Designed a lightweight, S3-compatible file storage server supporting resumable chunk uploads, SHA-256 checksum verification, and time-bound presigned URL generation. Built custom Express streaming middleware to pipe large binary objects directly to disk without loading entire payloads into server memory.
projects.architecture_highlights: Leverages MySQL for metadata indexing (buckets, objects, versions, ETag hashes) while keeping binary payloads stored in content-addressable storage blocks.
projects.metrics: Maintains steady 85MB/s streaming throughput with bounded 40MB Node.js RAM footprint.

projects.title: AlgoVision: Interactive Algorithm & Data Structure Simulator
projects.summary: Educational visualizer demonstrating Graph Traversals (Dijkstra, A*), Tree Rebalancing (AVL, Red-Black), and Sorting pipelines in 60 FPS.
projects.description: Crafted an intuitive interactive computer science learning tool for engineering students to understand complex algorithms step-by-step. Features variable execution speeds, custom test-case generators, stack frame breakdowns, and memory allocation diagrams.
projects.architecture_highlights: Separated pure algorithmic generator functions (yielding execution states) from canvas render loops, allowing bi-directional time-travel debugging.
projects.metrics: Used by 1,200+ engineering classmates during semester exam preparation; 60 FPS smooth rendering on mobile devices.

projects.title: CampusSync: University Portal & Event Management System
projects.summary: Comprehensive campus portal for technical symposium registration, attendance QR-scanning, and automated e-certificate generation.
projects.description: Developed an end-to-end college department event platform handling over 800+ student registrations. Includes automated dynamic PDF certificate creation with unique verification hashes, team formation matchmaking, and role-based coordinator dashboard.
projects.architecture_highlights: Relational database schema with 12 interconnected tables handling participants, teams, venues, and verification tokens. Bulk generated 850 certificates in 18 seconds.
projects.metrics: Managed 850+ active participants during annual engineering symposium with zero downtime.
